review.answer:
I have reviewed the pages and the blurring is wrong and needs to be changed. Issues:
The scan often misses the parts of the face
This rigid-lines model is to defined and the blur needs to have softer edges
The blurring is inconsistent: sometimes it's extremely intense and other times you can recognise the child because the blurring is barely there
The options are to refine the current model or to use another one. What other accurate models are available?
This is a selection to illustrate the problem.
The problems are not limited to those photos, the problems are on all photos
review.result: REJECTED - all faces; the blur method itself is to change before any sheet is remade
